cuts.item: TCP building operating budget funding (facility ops, removed from operating budget)

statements.statement: Town meeting funded TCP building costs with one-time free cash instead of the operating budget, since the building would not be operated the full year.
Estimated cost to put a new roof on the undecommissioned section of the TCP building, to be brought to Town Meeting as part of the FY28 capital plan if the building is kept.
